start.README.md:
# Incident archive

Everything here was exported from the incident tracker of Greywater Labs.

* `incidents/` holds one record per incident, in whichever format the commander used at the time:
  `*_report.txt` (formal report), `*.warroom.log` (chat log from the war room) or `*-summary.eml` (email summary).
* `addenda/` holds later amendments. An addendum that reclassifies a root cause is final and overrides the original record.
* `notes/` is general office chatter and is not part of the incident record.

Conventions: durations are measured from the first alert to the moment service was restored. An incident belongs to
the calendar month of its date of incident. Severity SEV-1 is the worst.

start.README.md:
# Incident archive

Everything here was exported from the incident tracker of Vandermere Brewhouse.

* `incidents/` holds one record per incident, in whichever format the commander used at the time:
  `*_report.txt` (formal report), `*.warroom.log` (chat log from the war room) or `*-summary.eml` (email summary).
* `addenda/` holds later amendments. An addendum that reclassifies a root cause is final and overrides the original record.
* `notes/` is general office chatter and is not part of the incident record.

Conventions: durations are measured from the first alert to the moment service was restored. An incident belongs to
the calendar month of its date of incident. Severity SEV-1 is the worst.

start.README.md:
# Incident archive

Everything here was exported from the incident tracker of Windrush Cove Labs.

* `incidents/` holds one record per incident, in whichever format the commander used at the time:
  `*_report.txt` (formal report), `*.warroom.log` (chat log from the war room) or `*-summary.eml` (email summary).
* `addenda/` holds later amendments. An addendum that reclassifies a root cause is final and overrides the original record.
* `notes/` is general office chatter and is not part of the incident record.

Conventions: durations are measured from the first alert to the moment service was restored. An incident belongs to
the calendar month of its date of incident. Severity SEV-1 is the worst.

start.README.md:
# Incident archive

Everything here was exported from the incident tracker of Larkhill Museum.

* `incidents/` holds one record per incident, in whichever format the commander used at the time:
  `*_report.txt` (formal report), `*.warroom.log` (chat log from the war room) or `*-summary.eml` (email summary).
* `addenda/` holds later amendments. An addendum that reclassifies a root cause is final and overrides the original record.
* `notes/` is general office chatter and is not part of the incident record.

Conventions: durations are measured from the first alert to the moment service was restored. An incident belongs to
the calendar month of its date of incident. Severity SEV-1 is the worst.

start.README.md:
# Incident archive

Everything here was exported from the incident tracker of Windrush Cove Bus Company.

* `incidents/` holds one record per incident, in whichever format the commander used at the time:
  `*_report.txt` (formal report), `*.warroom.log` (chat log from the war room) or `*-summary.eml` (email summary).
* `addenda/` holds later amendments. An addendum that reclassifies a root cause is final and overrides the original record.
* `notes/` is general office chatter and is not part of the incident record.

Conventions: durations are measured from the first alert to the moment service was restored. An incident belongs to
the calendar month of its date of incident. Severity SEV-1 is the worst.

start.README.md:
# Incident archive

Everything here was exported from the incident tracker of Vandermere Transit Cooperative.

* `incidents/` holds one record per incident, in whichever format the commander used at the time:
  `*_report.txt` (formal report), `*.warroom.log` (chat log from the war room) or `*-summary.eml` (email summary).
* `addenda/` holds later amendments. An addendum that reclassifies a root cause is final and overrides the original record.
* `notes/` is general office chatter and is not part of the incident record.

Conventions: durations are measured from the first alert to the moment service was restored. An incident belongs to
the calendar month of its date of incident. Severity SEV-1 is the worst.

start.README.md:
# Incident archive

Everything here was exported from the incident tracker of Elmstead Institute of Astronomy.

* `incidents/` holds one record per incident, in whichever format the commander used at the time:
  `*_report.txt` (formal report), `*.warroom.log` (chat log from the war room) or `*-summary.eml` (email summary).
* `addenda/` holds later amendments. An addendum that reclassifies a root cause is final and overrides the original record.
* `notes/` is general office chatter and is not part of the incident record.

Conventions: durations are measured from the first alert to the moment service was restored. An incident belongs to
the calendar month of its date of incident. Severity SEV-1 is the worst.

start.README.md:
# Incident archive

Everything here was exported from the incident tracker of Tarnholt Health Cooperative.

* `incidents/` holds one record per incident, in whichever format the commander used at the time:
  `*_report.txt` (formal report), `*.warroom.log` (chat log from the war room) or `*-summary.eml` (email summary).
* `addenda/` holds later amendments. An addendum that reclassifies a root cause is final and overrides the original record.
* `notes/` is general office chatter and is not part of the incident record.

Conventions: durations are measured from the first alert to the moment service was restored. An incident belongs to
the calendar month of its date of incident. Severity SEV-1 is the worst.

start.README.md:
# Incident archive

Everything here was exported from the incident tracker of Ironbridge Fen Brewing Company.

* `incidents/` holds one record per incident, in whichever format the commander used at the time:
  `*_report.txt` (formal report), `*.warroom.log` (chat log from the war room) or `*-summary.eml` (email summary).
* `addenda/` holds later amendments. An addendum that reclassifies a root cause is final and overrides the original record.
* `notes/` is general office chatter and is not part of the incident record.

Conventions: durations are measured from the first alert to the moment service was restored. An incident belongs to
the calendar month of its date of incident. Severity SEV-1 is the worst.

start.README.md:
# Incident archive

Everything here was exported from the incident tracker of Corrigal Medical Centre.

* `incidents/` holds one record per incident, in whichever format the commander used at the time:
  `*_report.txt` (formal report), `*.warroom.log` (chat log from the war room) or `*-summary.eml` (email summary).
* `addenda/` holds later amendments. An addendum that reclassifies a root cause is final and overrides the original record.
* `notes/` is general office chatter and is not part of the incident record.

Conventions: durations are measured from the first alert to the moment service was restored. An incident belongs to
the calendar month of its date of incident. Severity SEV-1 is the worst.

start.README.md:
# Incident archive

Everything here was exported from the incident tracker of Frostholm Sound Ferry Company.

* `incidents/` holds one record per incident, in whichever format the commander used at the time:
  `*_report.txt` (formal report), `*.warroom.log` (chat log from the war room) or `*-summary.eml` (email summary).
* `addenda/` holds later amendments. An addendum that reclassifies a root cause is final and overrides the original record.
* `notes/` is general office chatter and is not part of the incident record.

Conventions: durations are measured from the first alert to the moment service was restored. An incident belongs to
the calendar month of its date of incident. Severity SEV-1 is the worst.

start.README.md:
# Incident archive

Everything here was exported from the incident tracker of Inkwell Medical Centre.

* `incidents/` holds one record per incident, in whichever format the commander used at the time:
  `*_report.txt` (formal report), `*.warroom.log` (chat log from the war room) or `*-summary.eml` (email summary).
* `addenda/` holds later amendments. An addendum that reclassifies a root cause is final and overrides the original record.
* `notes/` is general office chatter and is not part of the incident record.

Conventions: durations are measured from the first alert to the moment service was restored. An incident belongs to
the calendar month of its date of incident. Severity SEV-1 is the worst.

start.README.md:
# Incident archive

Everything here was exported from the incident tracker of Blackthorn Theatre Company.

* `incidents/` holds one record per incident, in whichever format the commander used at the time:
  `*_report.txt` (formal report), `*.warroom.log` (chat log from the war room) or `*-summary.eml` (email summary).
* `addenda/` holds later amendments. An addendum that reclassifies a root cause is final and overrides the original record.
* `notes/` is general office chatter and is not part of the incident record.

Conventions: durations are measured from the first alert to the moment service was restored. An incident belongs to
the calendar month of its date of incident. Severity SEV-1 is the worst.

To: Ambrose Delshaw <adelshaw@blackthorn.example>, Corvin Nashworth <cnashworth@blackthorn.example>
Date: Thu 3 Oct 2030 10:00
Subject: INC-2030-033 summary: 'Jade'

Hello all,

A short summary of INC-2030-033. On 3 October 2030 the alarm on 'Jade' went off at 05:36 and we were fully back at 06:24, so the outage ran for 48 min. It was graded SEV-3. About 670 tickets were affected. The cause was overheating. I commanded the response; Una Ireberg, Ulric Talthorpe helped. The follow-up is tracked as FU-461.

Bastien
House Manager
